title: Completed restriction evaluation preserves the actual coefficient-system transition
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, and a scheme $W$. Use the coefficient sequence category, its derived category, evaluation $e_n$, quotient restriction $r_{m,n}$ and actual transition $\tau_{m,n}$ of [def-coef-ringed-sequence-site]. Let $U$ be the exact termwise restriction to completed-coefficient towers, $R_n$ the completed restriction at level $n$, $a_n:\operatorname{ev}_nU\cong R_ne_n$ the specified coefficientRestrictedEvaluationIso, and $c_{m,n}:R_mr_{m,n}\cong R_n$ the comparison compactSupportSystemRestrictionComp of [def-trf-compact-support-system-evaluation-diagram]. For every $n\leq m$ and every derived system $N$, the actual constant-tower transition $s_{m,n}$ satisfies $s_{m,n,UN}\,;\,a_{n,N}=a_{m,N}\,;\,R_m(\tau_{m,n,N})\,;\,c_{m,n,e_nN}$. No injectivity or cartesianness of $N$ is assumed.

source.place: Tags 0940/0941; coherence proof step 5, termwise restriction before the inverse limit

proof.text: Use the characterizations coefficientSequenceRestriction_exists and coefficientSequenceTransition_exists on every section. Transport through coefficientSequenceRestriction_evaluation. The limit-cone equation and coefficientRestrictionComp identify the successive scalar restrictions, whose underlying section map is unchanged. Module-sheaf extensionality gives the ordinary transition square. This is the restrictedTransition argument already proved privately in CoefficientSequenceRoosModel, specialized directly to the unrestricted completion projections.

Prove a private localization square lemma for exact functors. By Localization.natTrans_ext it suffices to check the equality on Q K. Cancel the target factorization isomorphisms, use the factorization formulas of the localized transition, evaluation isomorphisms and mapDerivedCategoryCompNatIso, and naturality to reduce to the ordinary square degreewise. Specialize to the sequence restriction, both tower evaluations and the finite scalar restriction. The resulting composite comparison is definitionally compactSupportSystemRestrictionComp. No normalization or injectivity is used.

proof_origin.place: Derived and homotopy limits (Tags 0940/0941), exact termwise restriction; localization proof adapted from the proved private derivedSquare and derivedRestrictedTransition in Sheaf.Paper.CoefficientSequenceRoosModel, group D8, 2026-10-27.

lean.statement:
theorem compactSupportCompletedRestrictionTransition
    (W : Scheme.{t}) {m n : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m)
    (N : coefficientSequenceDerived l E W) :
    (compactSupportConstantTowerTransition l E W h).app
        ((coefficientSequenceDerivedRestriction l E W).obj N) ≫
      (coefficientRestrictedEvaluationIso l E W n).hom.app N =
    (coefficientRestrictedEvaluationIso l E W m).hom.app N ≫
      (coefficientFiniteDerivedRestriction l E W m).map
        ((coefficientSequenceDerivedTransition l E W h).app N) ≫
      (compactSupportSystemRestrictionComp l E W h).hom.app
        ((coefficientSequenceDerivedEvaluation l E W n).obj N)
